You can edit this description to add more information about your campaign.","system":"D&D 5e","summary":"During the spring break at the Spring-Break Resort, students from The College gathered at a poolside bar, where [[Dookeldorn Bludvart]], a hooded man, sat alone in a dark booth. He opened up about his troubled past involving a dragon attack, which prompted [[E.t. Skittles]], a large turtle-like man, to engage with a distressed guard named [[Philip]] about a dragon threatening [[Byriver]]. [[Philip]] and [[E.t.]] began recruiting adventurers for a mission against the dragon [[Haldraxis]], leading [[Dookeldorn]] and [[Bronn Boromir]] to volunteer for the confrontation. The group received details about the dragon's demands and routes to the Old Temple Ruins before setting off with healing potions.

As the students converged at the crowded poolside bar, [[Dookeldorn]] was approached by three fellow students, Tracy, Lacey, and Stacy, who offered him healing and comfort. After sharing a toast, [[Dookeldorn]] revealed his experience of joining a mercenary group with his brother, detailing a disastrous encounter with a dragon that led to his brother's disappearance. Alarm spread among the group upon hearing the dragon's name, as it had also attacked [[By River]] that night. Recruitment for the dragon hunt began as [[Philip]] and [[E.t.]] approached the group, leading [[Dookeldorn]] to volunteer for the confrontation, with [[Bronn]] joining him.

The party ascended a mountain and discovered a meadow filled with Ice Flowers, which they carefully harvested. [[Bronn]] inquired about [[E.t.]]'s past, prompting [[E.t.]] to share a brief account of his life, mentioning his mixed feelings from others and living alone with raccoons. Around the campfire, personal histories were shared, with [[Bronn]] revealing his struggles with his prestigious family, [[Gideon Xander]] discussing his unpaid work under a professor, and [[Dookeldorn]] speaking of his presumed dead family and unveiling his brother's Moonbow, a treasured possession. The party camped overnight and engaged in morning activities before continuing their journey toward the Old Temple Ruins.

The group encountered a mountain giant near a cliff, which emerged from the mist and examined their gear. [[Dookeldorn]] attempted to shoot the giant but missed, while [[Gideon]] successfully commanded the giant to flee. [[Bronn]]'s attempt to cast Green-Flame Blade resulted in a missed attack, but [[E.t.]] cast Guiding Bolt, injuring the giant. As the giant fled, [[Gideon]] blessed it, and [[Bronn]] attacked from behind, leading to [[Dookeldorn]]'s final shot that killed the giant. After discovering a manifesto on a dead mountain giant, revealing that knights from [[By River]] were addressing giant issues, the party located a giant encampment and engaged in combat, defeating two [[Mountain Giants]] and confirming their alliance with [[Haldraxis]] against [[By River]]. Following a night of rest, [[E.t.]] sent a message home with Gil, who returned with acorns for [[E.t.]]'s raccoon roommates.

The party journeyed to the Old Temple Ruins after resting at a Giant Settlement, confirming the [[Mountain Giants]]' cooperation with [[Haldraxis]] against [[By River]]. Upon discovering a collapsed temple, [[Gideon]] found dragon prints and fresh dung, while [[Bronn]] set a trap. [[Haldraxis]] arrived, demanding overdue gold from [[Gideon]] and threatening the city, leading to a confrontation where [[Dookeldorn]] shot the dragon after a failed negotiation. The battle intensified with various attacks from the party, ultimately forcing [[Haldraxis]] to flee, vowing revenge on [[By River]].

The group identified [[Haldraxis]]'s flight path to its lair and noted his retreat after taunting them. [[Bronn]] argued for immediate pursuit to prevent [[Haldraxis]] from recovering, a sentiment echoed by [[Gideon]] due to the dragon's threat to [[By River]]. Choosing to press the attack, the group traveled up the mountain path, with [[Dookeldorn]] gathering herbs and keeping the group on course. They arrived at a cave resembling a dragon skull, observing scalding steam exhaling from its mouth. [[Dookeldorn]] suggested using Troll Fat as bait, which he threw into the cave, attracting attention from within. Upon entering the cave, they discovered a Workshop occupied by a Mountain Giant, whom they ambushed after creating a distraction. The giant was defeated and subsequently killed by [[Dookeldorn]] after revealing he was coerced by [[Haldraxis]].

After the giant's death, [[Dookeldorn]] desecrated the body and harvested more Troll Fat. The party discovered two traps in the Workshop and decided to use the leg snare as an ambush. [[Bronn]] imitated an injured giant to lure more inhabitants, while [[Gideon]] enhanced the deception by placing part of the dead giant in the forge. The ruse was successful as two [[Mountain Giants]] responded to the call. The party encountered the [[Mountain Giants]] in a steam chamber, where [[Dookeldorn]] shot one giant, causing [[E.t.]] to be knocked unconscious. After healing [[E.t.]], [[Gideon]] enabled him to kill the free giant, while [[Bronn]] used telekinetic force to knock the fleeing giant down a mountain, killing him. The party then discovered a side passage leading to a Dragon’s Treasure Chamber, where they found [[Haldraxis]] asleep near a [[Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold)]] of gold, still bearing a wound from their earlier encounter.

The party entered [[Haldraxis]]'s [[Hoard]] chamber and discovered the wounded dragon asleep beside a smaller-than-expected [[Hoard]]. After a discussion, they coordinated an ambush against [[Haldraxis]], with plans for [[Dookeldorn]] to shoot the dragon, [[Bronn]] to deliver [[Ice-Flower Petals]], and [[Gideon]] to enhance [[Bronn]]'s abilities. The ambush commenced as [[Gideon]] sang, prompting [[Dookeldorn]] to shoot [[Haldraxis]], reopening his wounds. [[Haldraxis]] awoke in rage, threatened destruction upon their city, and fled through the [[Mountainside Opening]] toward [[By River]].

The group assessed a dragon's [[Hoard]], estimating it to contain five thousand gold pieces, and noted the dragon's escape route overlooking a mountain river. After losing sight of the dragon, they chose to use [[Hang Gliders]] to descend to a [[Farmer's Field Beside By River]], where they heard the dragon beyond the gates. Upon arrival at the [[City Gate]], they encountered three [[Mountain Giants]], one of which attempted to lift the [[Gate]]. A battle ensued, resulting in the defeat of the [[Mountain Giants]], with [[Dookeldorn]] killing a sleeping giant before the [[Gate]] was opened by [[Philip]], who informed them of [[Haldraxis]]'s early arrival.

The party confronted [[Haldraxis]] at the [[Keep]], where a ballista bolt from the [[Tower Guards]] interrupted the dragon's attack, allowing them to enter safely. [[E.t.]] conjured a spiritual weapon and struck [[Haldraxis]], followed by [[Dookeldorn]]'s shot, culminating in [[E.t.]] delivering a fatal necrotic blow that caused the dragon to crash onto the roof. After looting the dragon's corpse, [[Dookeldorn]] found a handkerchief belonging to his brother, while [[E.t.]] fell unconscious attempting to use a hang glider. The townsfolk celebrated the party's victory, doubling their reward and offering accommodations, while [[Bronn]] sent a message to his uncle about their triumph.","language":"en","public":false,"mature":false,"owner_id":"b9a0a71b-eb62-455a-9e56-a596872a42e2","image":null,"archived":false,"archived_at":null}
